results.title: Quote of the day by Ram Dass: “Everything changes once we identify with being the witness to the story, instead of the actor in it”; What the Harvard psychedelic and Neem Karoli Baba follower advises on being an observer of life
results.description: Life frequently has us responding like actors on a stage, reacting to various situations around us. However, Ram Dass suggests we embrace the role of an observer to our own thoughts. By doing so, we create a space for liberation and impartial awareness. In today's fast-paced world, feelings of anxiety can chip away at our self-identity, but cultivating mindful observation can profoundly enhance our life experiences.
